title: GF2 VR Settings
subtitle: Review and save VR settings. Start the game manually.
activityPrimaryUiEnabled: Show Activity UI in primary view
activityUiSummary: Display ordinary and dialogue Activity UI in the primary VR view. Enabled by default.
activityUiHelp: Turning this off hides only the primary Activity UI. The 3D world and original auxiliary panel remain available. While enabled, opening the auxiliary panel hides primary UI and closing it restores it. Save and restart the game to apply.
renderSummary:
These are saved settings. Effective VR values are determined after restarting the game. PC and auxiliary-panel resolution stay independent.

Visual effects use the game defaults; this window does not provide individual effect controls.
navigationSummary: Default: left stick movement / right stick turning. Changing movement hand swaps both stick roles. Panel/pointer hands are selected separately on the Buttons tab.
conflictHelp: Panel-hand Grip prioritizes the panel: left by default, right when hands swap. Its Trigger owns WASD game mode; pointer Trigger prioritizes UI interaction. Choose at least one World Drag activation and tracked hand.
restart: Close the game before saving. Restart it manually to apply changes. Saving does not prove VR application. Numbers accept a decimal point (.) or exponent notation.
renderHelp: Neutral/default 1.0; development trial 0.6. At 0.6 the pixel count is about 36% of 1.0. No validated recommended range yet; entry is unrestricted. Device limits may reject application.
depthHelp: Calculated and read-only while linked; editable when OFF. Suggested 0.5–2, unrestricted input. Physical IPD/FOV stay unchanged.
handHelp: Default left. The other hand handles turning.
modeHelp: Default snap. Choose smooth for continuous view turning.
speedHelp: Default 1.0. Recommended range unconfirmed. Negative or nonfinite values cannot be applied.
multiplierHelp: Neutral/default 1.0. Configured speed = speed × multiplier. This does not change world scale.
snapHelp: Default 30°. 15/30/45/60° are suggested choices; other angles remain editable.
smoothHelp: Default 60. Not used while snap mode is selected.
deadzoneHelp: Default 0.2. Input normalization requires 0 ≤ value < 1; this is a semantic constraint, not a recommended-range clamp.
dragHelp: Default OFF. Choose activation buttons and tracked hands. Actual files stay unchanged until saved.
resetQuestion: Select defaults? Actual files change only when you press Save.
folderHelp: Select the game installation folder containing GF2 Game.
rootError: GF2 Game/GF2_Exilium.exe was not found in the selected installation folder.
pathError: The settings path is redirected or outside the installation. Choose the original installation folder.
sizeError: {0}: runtime settings must contain 1–4096 bytes. The file was preserved.
formatError: {0}: invalid format or field type. The original file was preserved.
schemaError: {0}: unsupported settings version. Newer files will not be overwritten.
duplicateError: Duplicate settings key: {0}. No value was selected by guess.
numberError: {0}: enter a finite nonnegative number. Resolution must be positive; deadzone must be below 1. Values outside recommendations are never clamped.
dragError: World Drag requires at least one activation button and one tracked hand.
speedError: Speed multiplied by its multiplier overflows numeric representation. Settings were preserved; saving stopped.
runningError: Close the game normally before saving. This tool does not start or close the game or SteamVR.
conflictError: Settings changed in another program. Nothing was overwritten. Reload and apply your changes again.
exportError: Export profiles with a separate name and location from runtime settings files.
profileError: This is not a valid GF2 VR settings profile. Current settings were preserved.
ioError: A file could not be read or saved. Check folder permissions and whether another program is using it.
runtimeError: The installed mod and settings path do not match this tool’s verified runtime contract. Settings were preserved. Use the configurator matched to that mod build.
rollbackError:
Saving failed and some files could not be fully restored. Check these backups before starting the game:
{0}
updateUnmanaged: No managed installation receipt; current files will stay unchanged.
updateAccess: Update checks require GitHub CLI signed in with your own account.
updateQuestion: Update to {0}? Close the game. Settings will close for replacement, then reopen.
updateFailed: Update check/preparation failed. Current installation and settings are preserved.
updateInvalid: Update asset/version/integrity could not be verified.
updateParent: Settings did not exit; update was cancelled.
updateAvailableVersion: Version {0} is available. Review and confirm to update.
controllerSummary: Panel/pointer hands and normal UI click/back buttons can be swapped independently. Both options default to off.
faceSwapHelp: Swap pointer-hand A/X click and B/Y back. While panel-hand Trigger is held, physical X/A→F, Y/B→ESC on both hands and locomotion-stick WASD stay unchanged. Save and restart.
handRolesHelp: Default: left panel / right pointer. Enable for right panel / left pointer. Panel Grip and game-mode Trigger follow the panel hand. Movement/turning sticks stay separate. Save and restart.
worldScaleSummary: Link perceived world size to eye separation and movement speed. 1 = 100%, 2 = 200%, 0.5 = 50%. Save and restart the game to apply.
worldScaleHelp: Default 1. Suggested initial adjustment 0.5–2. Direct input is unrestricted.
linkStereoDepthToWorldScale: Link Stereo Depth to World Scale
depthLinkHelp: Default ON: 1/World Scale. OFF keeps the current calculated depth as the manual value.
linkMovementSpeedToWorldScale: Link Movement Speed to World Scale
speedLinkHelp: Default ON: base speed × manual scale × World Scale. 200% = 2× speed; 50% = 0.5×. OFF removes only World Scale.
cameraFollowHelp: Default ON. Saved choice applies on the next game launch. Right stick click toggles it during play without changing the saved choice.
updateVariantPending: Current build preserved. Use an update package matching Clean or Dirty.
controllerHandsHelp: Enabled by default. Shared by Clean and Dirty. Save and restart the game.
handsSummary: Show both controller positions as white spheres in the HMD. Contact deformation is available in Dirty only.
panelRotationHelp: Defaults: Pitch -67 / Yaw 3 / Roll 0 degrees. Additional local Yaw × Pitch × Roll rotation. Suggested ±180 degrees; input is not clamped.
panelAnglePolicyHelp: Default off. On adds rotation and screen tilt while facing the viewer. Off applies manual angles only when Face the viewer is off. Inactive values are retained; position and size always apply.
panelApplyAnglesWhenFacing: Apply manual angles while facing viewer
panelSummary: Auxiliary panel only. Turn off Face the viewer to attach its orientation to the controller. Position uses controller-local axes in meters; angles add local rotation in degrees. Saving panel settings enables the reference placement model. Missing auxiliaryPanel preserves the previous layout. Restart the game after saving.
panelFacingHelp: Default on. On faces the viewer horizontally; off follows the controller. Choose below whether manual angles also apply while facing the viewer.
panelSizeHelp: Defaults: maximum width 0.66m / height 0.66m. Preserves the original aspect ratio within both limits. Sizes must be greater than zero. Restart the game after saving.
panelTiltHelp: Default 45 degrees. Positive tilts upward; negative downward, around the final screen horizontal axis without moving its center. Try +5 degrees for a slight tilt. Suggested ±45 degrees; values outside are accepted.
panelNumberError: {0}: enter a finite number. Positions/angles may be negative; sizes must be positive. Values not representable by native float are rejected.
panelOffsetHelp: Position follows the controller local axes. In the observed held pose: +X right / +Y forward / +Z up. The axes rotate with your hand. Defaults: X 0, Y -0.10, Z 0.01m. Suggested ±0.5m; values outside are accepted.
contactHapticStrengthHelp: Dirty only. Default 15%; suggested 5–30%. Set 0 to disable vibration. OpenXR supports 0–100%.
contactHapticDurationHelp: Dirty only. Default 30ms; suggested 10–80ms. Set 0 to disable vibration. One pulse on initial contact; fully separate before touching again. Restart the game after saving.
contactHapticStrengthError: Vibration strength must be a number from 0–100% representable by OpenXR.
contactHapticDurationError: Vibration duration must be 0 or at least 1ns, representable as 64-bit nanoseconds. Enter the value in ms.
loggingHelp: Default OFF. Enabling records VR diagnostic logs that can grow over time. Save and restart the game.
diagnosticsSummary: Shared by Clean and Dirty. Enable when troubleshooting. The one-time upgrade cleanup preserves existing logs for users with logging ON.
